en: The front of the postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand, multi-story building with classical architecture, tall windows, multiple dormers, and a long colonnaded entryway. People are seen walking, and there is a person riding a white horse in front of the building, as well as vintage cars parked by the side. The bottom of the front image is labeled 'Bad Pyrmont - Palmengarten.' The reverse side contains typical postcard layout, with German text indicating the publisher and location, and a logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' The phrase 'Schönster Kurpark Deutschlands' can be seen, meaning 'Most beautiful spa park in Germany.' There are also handwritten numbers and letters.
